events.text: Japan formally surrenders aboard USS Missouri, ending the Second World War.
Ho Chi Minh proclaims the independence of Vietnam in Hanoi.
The Great Fire of London begins in a bakery on Pudding Lane.
Britain uses the Julian calendar for the last time; the next day is 14 September.

births.text: Christa McAuliffe, American teacher and astronaut

deaths.text: J. R. R. Tolkien, English author of The Lord of the Rings
